A prisoner was escaping with help from a law-enforcement officer, who hid him inside a coffin alongside the officer’s own body. The coffin was being transported for the officer’s burial, and the officer planned to release the prisoner afterward. But the officer died before he could do so, and no one else knew the prisoner was inside. Buried in the tomb and trapped in the coffin with little breathable air, the man struck a match, recognized the officer’s face, and realized his only helper was dead. He died of suffocation.
